instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the entire task through the launched graphical user interfaces only. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, PowerShell, or any shell. Do not run Python, VBA, macros, Abaqus noGUI, ANSYS command scripts, batch/headless tools, APIs, or helper code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only the native SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE GUI tools, menus, dialogs, editors, and built-in import, export, save, submit, and solve commands.

Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_07. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_07 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_07 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.


1. In SolidWorks, use GUI sketch and feature tools only to create a 160 mm x 40 mm x 6 mm flat slotted link with one D14 eye hole near each end and a centered 60 mm x 12 mm through slot. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step through the GUI and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-SlottedLinkTension. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the link. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Tension. Create sets named LEFT_EYE, RIGHT_EYE, and SLOT_EDGE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh with modest local seeding only around SLOT_EDGE; do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-LeftEye that fixes LEFT_EYE. Create an action named Load-RightTension: either an approximately +1200 N axial tensile load on RIGHT_EYE, or an equivalent named axial displacement boundary condition on RIGHT_EYE. Submit the job named Job-SlottedLinkTension and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-SlottedLinkTension.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-SlottedLinkTension.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

[Software] Open and use SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE one at a time through the Windows GUI as needed. First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
notes: Controlled-diversity GUI chained CAE task with post-hoc chain evidence checks.
